title: LDAP configuration
searchFilterHint: LDAP filter to restrict login to specific groups. Combined with the user search via AND.
nestedGroupsHint: Members of sub-groups of the configured groups may log in too. Works with Active Directory only, not OpenLDAP.
allowedGroupsHint: Group names only, no DN — the app builds the DN itself (cn=Name,Base DN). Only members of these or the admin/moderator groups may log in; with no group configured no LDAP user can log in.
moderatorGroupsHint: If a user is in both an admin and a moderator group, admin wins.
